user_question: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Summarize mean elevation for the census tracts that intersect State College borough.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve State College borough boundary
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a polygon boundary for State College borough to identify intersecting census tracts.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve a candidate polygon boundary dataset covering State College borough. Runtime QC must verify the candidate's spatial coverage, geometry, CRS, and GeoPackage format before downstream use.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject borough boundary to census-tract CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Put the borough boundary and census tracts into a compatible CRS for intersection.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the retrieved borough boundary to EPSG:26918. Do not assign a CRS; the source CRS must be present in runtime metadata.

workflow_steps.title: Select census-tract areas intersecting State College borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Create polygon zones corresponding to the portions of supplied census tracts that intersect the borough boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform an intersection overlay between the supplied census tracts and the reprojected State College borough boundary. Runtime QC must verify compatible CRSs and valid geometries.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject intersecting tract zones to DEM CRS
workflow_steps.purpose: Align the intersection zones with the supplied elevation raster for zonal statistics.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the intersecting tract zones to EPSG:3857, matching the supplied DEM CRS. Preserve tract-identifying attributes produced by the overlay.

workflow_steps.title: Summarize mean elevation by intersecting census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute mean DEM elevation for each census-tract zone intersecting State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute zonal statistics using the DEM and the reprojected intersecting census-tract zones, producing a CSV summary with the mean elevation for each zone. Runtime QC must preserve and expose the tract identifier fields available in the zone layer.

requirements.scope: The retrieved borough boundary must cover State College borough.
The retrieved borough boundary must be available as a GeoPackage vector dataset.
